personal.name: Janak Sanjel
personal.headline: Building software that solves real-world problems.
personal.intro: I’m a backend-focused engineer in Lalitpur, Nepal. I design APIs, database schemas, and deployments for client systems, from accounting ledgers to government offices.

featured.title: Accounting Software
featured.description: A small-business accounting system covering income and expense tracking, invoicing, ledger management, financial reports, and balance sheets.

featured.title: FilesWow
featured.description: A privacy-first toolkit of 100+ free PDF, document, and image utilities. Files are processed in the browser, so most work never needs a server upload.

featured.title: GWP Palika Software
featured.description: A digital operations suite for Nepali local government offices. I built backend modules for citizen records, reporting, and service workflows.

featured.title: Training Management System
featured.description: An institute management platform for course scheduling, student enrolment, attendance tracking, and progress reporting.

featured.title: Gym Management System
featured.description: Member registration, subscription billing, attendance tracking, and staff management, built with full end-to-end ownership.

paragraphs: I’m a full-stack developer and project manager who owns backend delivery: REST API design, relational schemas, and deployment. At NIRC I’ve shipped more than ten live systems, mostly on Python and Django with React frontends.

I also run sprint planning, talk to clients directly, and mentor junior engineers. My database background is MySQL-heavy, and I’m now building applied skills in AWS and PostgreSQL, aiming for larger-scale, cloud-native backend work.

highlights: Project manager and developer across 10+ concurrent client projects: requirements, sprint planning, client communication, and delivery.
Owned schema design, REST API contracts, and deployment for 10+ live production systems.
Built Django REST Framework backends with ReactJS frontends. Working directly with clients cut feedback cycles by about 30%.
Designed MySQL schemas for accounting ledgers, recruitment pipelines, gym subscriptions, training records, and municipal data.
Used event-driven patterns to separate long-running work, such as notifications and report generation, from request cycles.
Built a Flutter app and managed it from development to release on the Google Play Store.
Led code reviews and technical planning, and mentored junior engineers on API design and Django best practices.

skills.Backend: Python (primary), Django, Django REST Framework, REST API design, event-driven patterns, Node.js, Java, Grails
skills.Frontend: ReactJS, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3
skills.Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Android, published on Google Play
skills.Databases: MySQL (schema design, query optimisation, indexing), Django ORM, PostgreSQL (developing)
skills.Tools & cloud: Git, GitHub, deployment and rollback workflows, AWS (developing)
skills.Delivery: Project management, sprint planning, Agile / Scrum, client communication, mentoring
